# StreamDek Mobile v2.0.8

## What's New

- Added a "Clear all" action to the Continue Watching page to remove every in-progress title at once.
- Added "Watch on StreamDek TV" to the long-press menu on Continue Watching cards, on both Home and the Continue page. It resumes on the TV from where you left off, using the source that was already working on your phone.
- Added the handoff button to the player while watching live TV, next to the favourites star, so a live channel can be sent to a TV without leaving playback.
- Added a "Clear all" action to the Live Favourites page.
- Added a text list layout to "View All" pages, alongside the two- and three-column card grids. Live TV and network pages can now switch layout too, which suits long IPTV channel lists.
- Added renaming for connected TVs under Settings > Connect to TV, so televisions are easy to tell apart when choosing where to send playback.
- Added categories to Live TV and playlist "View All" pages. Channels are grouped by the categories your playlist or add-on publishes, and StreamDek sorts them for you when it publishes none. Tap a category to see its channels; searching still looks across the whole catalogue. Playlists can also be filtered one at a time when more than one is on.
- Added "Group Live TV Into Categories" under Settings > Home and Appearance to turn the new grouping off and go back to a single flat list.
- Added Sync Services under Settings, replacing the Trakt row. Trakt now sits alongside SIMKL and MDBList, each connected separately for the profile you are using.
- Added a primary service choice to Sync Services. One connected service supplies your Home rows and Continue Watching, and the rest keep receiving every watchlist change, so connecting more than one never doubles up rows or disagrees about your progress.
- Added a "Copy code" button to the Trakt and SIMKL pairing screens.

## Improvements

- Favourite channels are now marked with a star on "View All" pages in every layout, not just on landscape live cards.
- The Live TV favourites row and its "View All" page are now both titled "Live Favourites".
- A renamed TV shows its custom name everywhere playback can be sent — the player's handoff dialog, the Live TV and Continue Watching menus, and their status messages — while Settings still shows the name the TV reports for itself.
- Disconnecting a TV now clears any custom name saved for it
- Large IPTV playlists now show a progress notice while their categories are being sorted, instead of a blank page.
- MDBList access key is now saved per profile rather than per account, so each profile can use its own.
- The web control centre now matches the app: live TV card and category options, ambient intensity, player engine, preferred audio language, and add-on catalogue ratings can all be changed from the browser.
- Each service on the Sync Services page now shows its own logo and says whether it is driving your Home rows or mirroring your watchlist.
- In the web control centre, plugin sources now fold away under the collection that provides them, and dropdown menus are easier to spot and match the rest of the site.

## Fixes

- Fixed the favourites star on a live channel's detail page doing nothing when the channel was already a favourite.
- Fixed the favourites star in the player not switching off: a channel could be added but never removed. Favourites saved more than once by earlier versions are cleaned up automatically.
- Fixed the long-press menu on "View All" pages offering "Add to Favourites" for channels that were already favourited.
- Fixed the watchlist button on a title's detail page not removing the title once it was saved. Titles saved through Trakt could not be removed at all, and a title could end up saved twice when its type was recorded differently by different sources.
- Fixed downloaded titles losing track of what they were. A downloaded movie or episode you had started watching showed no artwork in Continue Watching, and tapping it opened an unrelated title instead of resuming the saved file. Downloads now remember the title they belong to, so they show their own poster, open the right page, and play from your device. Titles downloaded by earlier versions play from your device too, and no longer open the wrong page.
- Fixed downloaded episodes being recorded as movies, which left them without their season and episode number.
- Fixed a resumed download failing to open when the player engine was set to MPV, which cannot read saved files.
